epi.head: What Came After
epi.intro.win: The war was over. The rats who came back scattered to their homes.
epi.intro.lose: The war was lost. Still, some rats survived.
epi.pow: Spent two years in a POW camp after the Republic fell.
epi.story.0: Went back to {0} with a bundle of unsent letters. Their daughter still has them.
epi.story.1: Reopened the bakery in {0}. On opening day, the old squad came and bought every loaf.
epi.story.2: Searched for their brother for three years after the war. They found each other one winter at the train station in {0}.
epi.story.3: Never went back to {0}. There was no home left. Built a home for war orphans instead.
epi.story.4: Sang in a tavern after being discharged. The last song was always the one from the trenches.
epi.story.5: The day they came home to {0}, Mother stood at the door holding a wheel of cheese.
epi.story.6: That autumn in {0}, married the one from the photo in the helmet.
epi.story.7: Was only sixteen when the war ended. Went back to school and became a teacher.
epi.story.8: Went to see the sea a week after being discharged. Lived by the shore for the rest of their life.
epi.story.9: Went back to fixing watches in {0}. On the shop wall hung a stopped pocket watch.
epi.story.10: Paid off every debt. Never touched a card again. Said they'd used up all their luck in the war.
epi.story.11: Went back to the hometown cathedral choir. Every Armistice Day, read out the names of fallen comrades one by one.
epi.story.none: Went back to {0}. Talked about the war only to those who asked.
epi.leg: Wore a wooden leg in place of the lost one. Hated stairs, but danced to the very end on their wedding day.
epi.arm: Even with one arm, still lifted the grandchildren up high.
epi.sib.alive: Built a house side by side with {0} on the same street. There was no fence between the two.
epi.comrade.dead: Every year, left a piece of cheese on {0}'s grave.
epi.comrade.alive: Ate cheese with {0} every Sunday for the rest of their lives.
epi.mentor: As {0} had taught, was first up and last to bed for the rest of their life.
epi.pupil: Tried to read a toast at {0}'s wedding. Never made it to the end.
epi.feud: Never made peace with {0}. Still sat in the front row at {0}'s funeral.
epi.scarred: Still wakes up on nights when it thunders. Never told anyone about that day.
epi.psychic: Sometimes talked to an empty chair. No one ever asked who was listening.
epi.end.medals: Put the medals in a drawer. Never took them out again.
epi.end.reunion: Held the squad reunion for forty years without missing one.
epi.end.1: Whenever the war came up, always said the same thing: “I got lucky.”
epi.end.2: Felt guilty for the rest of their life for coming home alive.
epi.end.3: Buried on a hill near {0}. The headstone bears only their name and the name of the squad.
epi.end.4: Lived past ninety. Kept the helmet to the very end.
epi.roll.head: Those Who Didn't Return
epi.roll.none: Not a single rat lost. Squads like that were rare.
epi.quote:
“I wasn't a hero. I just served in a squad full of them.”
— {0} {1}
